purpose: A public, claim-calibrated projection of research concepts, formal artifacts, experiments, evidence, and publication state.
epistemic_rule: A graph edge records a typed relationship; it is not evidence that the source node is true.

node_types.definition: A named concept or quantity with an explicit meaning.
node_types.model: An explicit formal or computational model with assumptions.
node_types.axiom: A proposition explicitly held in a profile or formal environment.
node_types.statement: A descriptive or explanatory proposition not represented as a proved theorem.
node_types.theorem: A named formally proved declaration with a bounded model/scope.
node_types.claim: A manuscript-level proposition tracked in the claims ledger.
node_types.hypothesis: A testable proposition not yet established by the available evidence.
node_types.empirical_result: A result emitted by a bounded experiment or measurement run.
node_types.experiment: A protocol or executable instrument that produces results.
node_types.artifact: A source, paper, repository, receipt, code file, or other inspectable object.
node_types.evidence: A receipt or observation used to establish artifact state or result provenance.
node_types.question: An unresolved research question or future test.
node_types.publication: A public release event or public location for an artifact.

status_values.conceptual: Part of the proposed framework; not independently established.
status_values.descriptive: A source description or vocabulary item.
status_values.formalized: Encoded in a formal or computational representation.
status_values.locally_validated: Passed local build/check or deterministic validation.
status_values.proved: A formal declaration checked by the relevant proof system.
status_values.measured: Produced by an executed bounded instrument.
status_values.published_source: Available at a public source location.
status_values.profile_held: Explicitly represented in the author's profile commitment layer.
status_values.unresolved: Known but not yet resolved or adequately evidenced.
status_values.superseded: Retained for provenance but no longer the current formulation.

edge_relations.defines: Source gives the meaning of target concept.
edge_relations.formalizes: Source encodes target proposition/model; does not by itself prove it.
edge_relations.proves: A formal artifact proves a named theorem under its assumptions.
edge_relations.depends_on: Target cannot be interpreted or built without source dependency.
edge_relations.conceptually_depends_on: Research framing dependency without a formal import/build dependency.
edge_relations.implements: Code or protocol implements target model/instrument.
edge_relations.measures: Experiment emits or measures target quantity.
edge_relations.supports: Evidence supports target claim under stated scope.
edge_relations.tests: Experiment is designed to test target hypothesis/claim.
edge_relations.falsifies: Evidence or result contradicts target under its declared contract.
edge_relations.qualifies: Source narrows, limits, or conditions target claim.
edge_relations.motivated_by: Artifact was created in response to or inspired by target concept.
edge_relations.published_as: Artifact is exposed through target publication location.
edge_relations.verified_by: Artifact state is independently checked by target evidence/receipt.
edge_relations.supersedes: Current node replaces an earlier formulation.
edge_relations.contradicts: Nodes make incompatible claims under comparable scope.

integrity_rules: Every edge endpoint resolves to a node.
Every node has at least one source reference.
Every claim and hypothesis has a falsifier or an explicit reason it is not yet falsifiable.
Formal dependency edges require evidence from imports/build metadata; conceptual relations use conceptually_depends_on or motivated_by.
Published source, proved, measured, and profile_held are independent status dimensions and must not be collapsed into one badge.
Inferred groupings must be marked in provenance and must not be rendered as direct source facts.
Private credentials, tokens, internal secrets, and private identifiers are forbidden in public graph data.
public_projection_rule: AxiomReason profile nodes are a commitment/derivation projection. The full research graph may contain descriptive, measured, hypothesized, and unresolved nodes without converting them into profile-held axioms.
